props.text: Twelve songs recorded live over eleven days. Out now everywhere, and on tour this winter.
“The most exciting live show I have seen in years. I walked out changed.”
Tickets for the tour are on sale now. For booking and press, send us a message.
The story so far, and who is in the room.
What began in a borrowed room has become a life on the road: three records, hundreds of shows and a sound that keeps changing.
Every release is recorded live wherever possible and mixed with the people who were in the room. The new material is the most honest work yet.
Live rooms, vintage desks and engineers who care about the take.
Records that translate from headphones to festival stages.
Honest guidance on songs, sound and strategy.
Record, mix and master one song.
From first demo to final master.
News, diaries and notes from the road.
